name: Take the order
entry: proposed: The customer begins checkout with a basket
exit: proposed: Order placed: committed and recorded with an order number
source: reference models (APQC PCF, SCOR; checkout, order-management, payment and warehouse practice), reconciled with the code

name: Accept the order
exit: proposed: Order accepted and released to fulfilment: payment authorised, stock reserved, risk cleared, customer told. Alternative exit: rejected, which ends the flow
source: reference models (APQC PCF, SCOR; checkout, order-management, payment and warehouse practice), reconciled with the code

name: Pack the order
entry: proposed: The order is waiting to be picked
source: reference models (APQC PCF, SCOR; checkout, order-management, payment and warehouse practice), reconciled with the code

name: Dispatch the order
entry: proposed: The parcel is waiting for collection
exit: proposed: Shipped: in the carrier's custody
source: reference models (APQC PCF, SCOR; checkout, order-management, payment and warehouse practice), reconciled with the code

name: Deliver the order
entry: proposed: Shipped; the case is with the carrier
exit: proposed: Delivered, with proof of delivery (the ending outcome)
source: reference models (APQC PCF, SCOR; checkout, order-management, payment and warehouse practice), reconciled with the code

name: Fill the basket
entry: proposed: the signed-in customer is looking for something to buy
exit: proposed: the basket holds what the customer wants for now; the basket then sits, with nothing moving it, until the customer comes back
source: the code's own two stages (basket-api, webapp); reference practice divides the flow differently

name: Take the basket to checkout
entry: proposed: the customer comes back to a basket that holds items
exit: proposed: the basket is taken to checkout, the start of Placing an order; or it is left
source: the code's own two stages (basket-api, webapp); reference practice divides the flow differently
